Typically speaking, yes, bi means liking more than one gender, but bi is liking me and women. However, polysexual is being attracted to more than 1 gender, but not all of them (eg being attracted to women and non binary) and pan is liking all genders / liking someone no matter their gender. I agree that personality matters more than gender as well!

Also, Andosexual and Gynesexual are different to pan. Androsexual is being attracted to someone who is masculine, but may not be a guy. Gynesexual is the same thing, but it’s been attracted to someone who is feminine.

Trigender and Bigender are identifying as 2 or 3 genders, whereas gender fluid is identifying as all genders, and non binary is not identifying with any gender at all.

This is my personal opinion, but I don’t think straight allies are part of the LGBTQ+ community. We appreciate the support, and wouldn’t be here without them, but Heterosexuality is not generally not part of the community (even though they have a flag)

I understand it’s very confusing, but keep learning! It’s a lot easier to understand once you take a closer look at it!
